mcnemar.note: descriptive only: the cases are not independent (several seeds of the same puzzle)

decision_rule: The hard-v18 screen replicates if RELAY rescues at least 3 more cases than REPLACE with 0 wrong in RELAY (McNemar descriptive: 6 puzzles). The in-swarm relay study proceeds only if, pooled over both screens, RELAY rescues more cases than REPLACE with 0 wrong.
decision: evaluate the frozen rule against the facts
disclosure: Weaknesses that remain in arms.py-driven arms (arms.py is pinned; disclose in reports): flush_caches ignores the ssh exit status and the HTTP status (only the response text is recorded), delta() accepts negative deltas after a counter reset, parse() counts a missing counter as 0 and accepts non-finite values, wait_idle() returns a busy snapshot after its limit without failing, and an energy failure does not change the exit code.
